summary: This Form 8-K, filed by BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2026-5C41, reports the execution of an underwriting agreement and a certificate purchase agreement for the sale of public and private commercial mortgage pass-through certificates. The public certificates have an aggregate principal amount of $472,934,000, and the private certificates total $60,701,596, with a scheduled closing date of May 21, 2026. There is no change of control, tender offer, activist campaign, or other special situation. The filing is a routine disclosure of a securitization transaction — the issuance of asset-backed securities — and fits none of the targeted special-situation categories.
